title: SealedPayloadPolicy v1 — encrypted payloads as data: the law is constants — a sensitive task kind's content may never travel in plaintext (plaintext_for_sensitive_allowed always false) and sealing is exactly one named construction (algorithm always x25519-hkdf-sha256-hmac-v1: an ephemeral X25519 exchange to the executing node's sealing key, HKDF-SHA256 key separation, an HMAC-SHA256 keystream, and an encrypt-then-MAC HMAC over header and ciphertext); which kinds are sensitive is the operator's list (sensitive_kinds), and max_payload_bytes, max_sealed, and max_nodes bound the door (Y-070)
